e.title: NN for FreqSev Pricing (KU Leuven)
e.summary: 频率-严重度定价神经网络基准（KU Leuven，12★，arXiv:2310.12671）：CANN/自动编码器/GBM 输入的定价 NN + 可解释工具
e.summary_en: Frequency-severity pricing NN benchmark (KU Leuven, 12★, arXiv:2310.12671): CANN/autoencoder/GBM-input pricing NNs + interpretability tools
e.summary_hk: 頻率-嚴重度定價神經網絡基準（KU Leuven，12★，arXiv:2310.12671）：CANN/自動編碼器/GBM 輸入的定價 NN + 可解釋工具
e.body:
NN for FreqSev Pricing（Freek Holvoet、Katrien Antonio、Roel Henckaerts，KU Leuven，12★）是论文《Neural networks for insurance pricing with frequency and severity data: a benchmark study from data preprocessing to technical tariff》（arXiv:2310.12671）的配套代码：频率-严重度数据的定价神经网络——自动编码器训练、输入归一化、CANN 模型（GBM 输入）与可解释工具（代理模型）。对 RIAA：精算定价 NN 的学术代码——[[insurance-dependent-fs]]（burning-cost 依赖频率-严重度 NN）的基准研究版；CANN（GBM+NN 组合，[[insurance-nested-glm]] 同类）；Katrien Antonio（[[workshop-loss-reserv-fraud]] 同作者）团队；与 [[insurance-frequency-severity]]（联合建模）、[[insurance-distill]]（蒸馏）配套；适合定价 NN 研究。

## 同类工具
[[offsetreg]]、[[openfair]]、[[opie-engine]]、[[actsim]]、[[actuarcredibility]]
e.body_en:
NN for FreqSev Pricing (Freek Holvoet, Katrien Antonio, Roel Henckaerts, KU Leuven, 12★) is the code accompanying the paper 'Neural networks for insurance pricing with frequency and severity data: a benchmark study from data preprocessing to technical tariff' (arXiv:2310.12671): pricing neural networks for frequency-severity data — autoencoder training, input normalisation, CANN models (GBM input) and interpretability tools (surrogate models). For RIAA: academic code for actuarial pricing NNs — the benchmark-study version of [[insurance-dependent-fs]] (burning-cost dependent frequency-severity NN); CANN (GBM+NN combination, similar to [[insurance-nested-glm]]); from the Katrien Antonio team (same author as [[workshop-loss-reserv-fraud]]); pairs with [[insurance-frequency-severity]] (joint modelling) and [[insurance-distill]] (distillation); suits pricing NN research.

## Similar tools
[[offsetreg]]、[[openfair]]、[[opie-engine]]、[[actsim]]、[[actuarcredibility]]
